findings: Filename-safe node naming was required for deep proposal/control chains; fixed with stable parent-lineage hashing.
Dense matched controls were generated for attribution and excluded from expansion parents so they do not preempt artifact-child search.
Executable source-backed artifacts enabled 24 trained foundation-artifact children; no strict artifact blocker was hit among selected rollouts.
Best generated child improved over the best root but did not reach the 0.44 target in this 32-rollout budget.
next_policy_changes: Increase trained-node budget or epochs if the next objective is reaching 0.44 rather than framework validation.
Add explicit target-reached early stop to HELF runner if not already enforced by higher-level entrypoint.
Keep source-backed artifact proposals paired with dense controls for attribution.
